title: Regions and availability
summary: An Azure region is a geographic area. Many regions offer availability zones, which provide separate physical locations within the region.
introduction: An Azure region is a geographic area. Many regions offer availability zones, which provide separate physical locations within the region. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.title: Regions and availability

blocks.text: Service features vary by region. A region name alone does not guarantee every feature is available.
